deviations.what: Canvas 1 'O4b Set your PIN · six digits · iPhone' and c11 'O4b Set your PIN · iPhone': Body copy (bodyLarge / bodyMedium: subtitles, the forgot-page body, status lines) draws with Material's inherited tracking — 0.5 px on bodyLarge, 0.25 px on bodyMedium — at 16 px, where the canvas sets 15.5 px untracked; the O4b subtitle wraps to four lines where the frame takes three, and the S15.3 forgot body breaks one word earlier
deviations.reason: [shared] theme text styles (app/lib/shared/theme.dart rkTextTheme): Material's inherited letterSpacing (0.5 bodyLarge, 0.25 bodyMedium, 0.1–0.5 labels) is never zeroed, so every run of body/label text is wider than the canvas's untracked Mukta. No token defines tracking (tokens.json type.scale carries none) and RkType.body sets no letterSpacing, so ThemeData merges rkTextTheme over the M3 defaults (theme_data.dart `defaultTextTheme.merge(textTheme)`; typography.dart bodyLarge letterSpacing 0.5). The fix is one line in rkTextTheme (letterSpacing: 0 for every slot) and changes every screen at once — foundation work outside this lane's folders; overriding it per screen would hide the defect. 15.5 px maps to the body role (16 px) by rule. Open item to the theme owner (KEY145B review finding 4)
deviations.authority: app/lib/shared/theme.dart rkTextTheme — outside this lane's folders (open item); ADR 2026-10-05 §1 (tokens.json decides values: type.body 16)
